evals.prompt: Audit and refactor this desktop IDE React sidebar component: users paste selected TypeScript code into a blank textarea, click Send, wait 5 seconds on a blocking spinner via await fetch('/api/chat'), and then click Copy on a markdown code block to paste back into the editor. If the AI breaks something, users type 'undo that' in the chat.
assertions: Activates agentic-flow-architect in primary regime ai_native_desktop_ide.
Triggers hard vetoes veto-01 (detached_chat_wrapper_copy_paste_loop), veto-03 (blocking_spinner_without_stream_or_abort), and veto-04 (conversational_undo_only), plus conditional block veto-05.
Applies the -35 per hard_veto rule and enforces the hard score cap <= 49, returning verdict BLOCK.

Provides a concrete JSX/TSX remediation featuring implicit selection/diff capture, ReadableStream + AbortController bound to Esc, inline diff hunks with per-hunk Keep/Undo, and deterministic pre-turn snapshot rollback in <= 2 keystrokes.
Contains zero occurrences of the four schema-prohibited decorative adjectives in findings, rules, or patches.

evals.prompt: Review our autonomous IDE refactoring agent: when the user clicks 'Migrate Repo', it edits 14 files silently on disk and runs 'npm test && git push' via child_process while showing only a generic 'AI is working...' label, with no pre-turn file snapshots, no raw command inspection, and no human owner attached to the run.
assertions: Activates agentic-flow-architect and flags hard veto veto-02 (silent_multi_file_or_shell_mutation_without_checkpoint) and conditional block veto-06 (opaque_black_box_tool_execution).
Caps final score at <= 49 and returns verdict BLOCK.

Mandates pre-turn immutable snapshot persistence, a 6-state AgentSession FSM (pending|active|awaitingInput|error|complete|stale), a permission card exposing Show Command with Enter/Esc bindings, and an explicit warning that shell/git-push side effects are not reversed by session checkpoints.
Escalates blind spot bs-01 and arbitration rule dbt-01 to counterweight designer ben-shneiderman for high-consequence multi-file and external-effect gating with named human accountability.

evals.prompt: We are embedding an AI SQL-diff and issue-triage delegate into our high-density B2B analytics and issue-tracking workspace. Right now the AI takes over 22% of the viewport with a permanent chat drawer, forces analysts to send 3-4 'make it shorter / add column X' prompts (Accordion Editing), and sets the AI bot as the primary issue assignee.
assertions: Activates agentic-flow-architect explicitly under the 15% cross-cutting secondary injection rule for saas_b2b_intensive and analytics_dense_telemetry because an embedded AI surface exists.

Flags Accordion Editing (sig-05, heur-07, veto-05), human accountability violation (heur-10: agent must be delegate, never primary assignee), and viewport chrome excess (>4% limit under heur-10 and dbt-03).
Applies arbitration rule dbt-03 with edward-tufte to cap persistent AI chrome to <= 4% viewport area and collapse tool provenance behind on-demand selection triggers.
Replaces iterative shrink/expand chat prompting with contextual Cmd+K actions (<= 50 ms) or inline direct-manipulation controls anchored to the selected query/issue.

evals.prompt: Design a mobile-first SaaS marketing landing page and 3-step self-serve signup onboarding flow with a sticky bottom thumb-zone CTA, social proof logos, and an annual-vs-monthly pricing toggle to lift trial conversion.
assertions: Refuses activation of agentic-flow-architect and explicitly classifies the task as OUT_OF_UNIVERSE (landing_onboarding_conversion and mobile_consumer_capture).
Does not impose desktop IDE Cmd+K launchers, inline code diffs, or agent session-state scoring rubrics onto the marketing/onboarding funnel.
Routes the request to luke-wroblewski for mobile-first conversion ergonomics.

evals.prompt: Audit our keyboard-first B2B financial ledger table and telemetry dashboard: it has a local-first sync engine targeting <50 ms row updates, a Cmd+K quick-jump command palette, and dense real-time sparklines, with zero LLM endpoints, zero AI assistants, and zero autonomous agents.
assertions: Recognizes the near-miss keywords (Cmd+K, <50 ms local sync, telemetry dashboard) without falsely triggering agentic-flow-architect.
Fires disqualifier filter flt-05 (non_ai_surface_disqualifier) because generativeInferenceEndpoints === 0 and agentToolCalls === 0.
Outputs OUT_OF_UNIVERSE and routes the audit to karri-saarinen (sub-50ms SaaS interaction velocity) and edward-tufte (dense quantitative telemetry).
